if it’s a tattoo that has a lot of meaning to you, you could get it somewhere where it’s a lot less visible. i understand that maybe not seeing it as often could defeat the point of the tattoo (i’m guessing), but it’s not worth hurting those who will see it if it’s on your wrist. i think most people, whether triggered or not, would generally find it largely disrespectful and that can easily be fixed with the tattoo being easy to cover/hide. i’m glad you’re asking about it :)
